caseNameFull: Anna Hawley, in Error v. Joseph W. Walker, Constable, etc.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Ohio.
attorneys: Mr. J. M. Sheets for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Louis D. Brandeis, Mr. Timothy S. Hogan, Mr. Frank Davis, Jr., and Mr. Clarence D. Laylin for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Per Curiam. Judgment affirmed with costs, upon the authority of Muller v. Oregon, 208 U. S. 412 ; Lindsley v. Natural Carbonic Gas Co., 220 U. S. 61, 78, 79.
